translations.web: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves.
translations.bsb: Your wrath weighs heavily upon me; all Your waves have submerged me. Selah
translations.kjv: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
